name: Injoku Hitozuma Onna Kyoushi
source:
The main character is a high school student, who belongs to a photo club. He is not interested in love romance but erotic things. There are wonderful and beautiful married female teachers in his school. He tries to take photos of their secrets and live an erotic school life. Will he be able to control those beautiful women...?
